description: Topic continuity on annual leave: office comparison, how to request, notice and carry-over, with elliptical follow-ups.

turns.user: How many days of annual leave do people in the Barcelona office get?
turns.standalone: How many days of paid annual leave do Northwind employees in the Barcelona office get per year?
expected_texts: Barcelona: 23 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

turns.user: And for Stockholm?
turns.standalone: How many days of paid annual leave do Northwind employees in the Stockholm office get per year?
expected_texts: Stockholm: 25 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

turns.user: How do I request it?
turns.standalone: How do I request annual leave at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: All annual leave is requested in PeopleHub using form HR-17 (Leave Request).

turns.user: How far ahead if I want two weeks off?
turns.standalone: How much notice do I need to give when requesting two weeks of annual leave at Northwind?
expected_texts: Absences of more than 3 working days need at least 10 working days of notice.

turns.user: What if I don't use all of them by December?
turns.standalone: What happens to annual leave days that a Northwind employee has not used by the end of the year?
expected_texts: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over into the following calendar year.

description: Topic continuity on the support SLA for P1 tickets: response, resolution, successive escalation levels and the status page.

turns.user: What's the first response time for a P1 support ticket?
turns.standalone: What is the first response time target for a P1 customer support ticket at Northwind?
expected_texts: P1: first response within 30 minutes and resolution within 4 hours.

turns.user: And how long until it has to be solved?
turns.standalone: What is the resolution time target for a P1 customer support ticket at Northwind?
expected_texts: P1: first response within 30 minutes and resolution within 4 hours.

turns.user: What happens if nobody updates it?
turns.standalone: What happens when a P1 customer support ticket receives no update?
expected_texts: If a P1 ticket has no update for 30 minutes, it escalates to the duty manager.

turns.user: What about after that?
turns.standalone: After a P1 support ticket has been escalated to the duty manager, what is the next escalation step if it is still unresolved?
expected_texts: If it is still unresolved after 2 hours, the Head of Support takes over communication with the customer.

turns.user: Where can the customer follow it in the meantime?
turns.standalone: Where can a customer follow the progress of a P1 incident at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: Service status is published at status.northwind-payments.example.

turns.user: How often is it replaced?

turns.user: And if it gets stolen, what do I do first?

turns.user: How early should I book it?
turns.standalone: How far in advance should a business flight be booked at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: Flights should be booked at least 14 days before departure.

turns.user: Sorry, I meant the annual plan, not monthly.
turns.standalone: How much does the Northwind Payments Growth plan cost when it is billed annually?
expected_texts: With annual billing, Growth works out at 211.65 EUR per month.

turns.user: How many API calls does that include?
turns.standalone: How many API calls per month are included in the Northwind Payments Growth plan?
expected_texts: Growth (plan code PLAN-GR) costs 249 EUR per month and includes 100,000 API calls per month.

turns.user: And if we go over?
turns.standalone: What is charged when a customer on the Northwind Payments Growth plan exceeds the included API calls?

description: Comparison of the Starter and Scale pricing plans, with follow-ups that refer to 'the first one', 'the cheaper one' and 'the more expensive one'.

turns.user: What do the Starter and Scale plans cost per month?

Scale (plan code PLAN-SC) costs 899 EUR per month and includes 500,000 API calls per month.

turns.user: How many team seats does the first one include?
turns.standalone: How many team seats are included in the Northwind Payments Starter plan?

turns.user: Does the cheaper one come with webhooks?
turns.standalone: Does the Northwind Payments Starter plan include webhooks?

turns.user: Which support level do you get with the more expensive one?
turns.standalone: Which support tier do customers on the Northwind Payments Scale plan receive?

turns.user: And what does it charge per card payment?

description: Long 20-turn session by a new joiner moving across four topics (onboarding, remote work, expenses, security) with three topic switches, two unanswerable turns and many pronoun or elliptical follow-ups.

turns.user: I start next Monday. What time should I show up on the first day?
turns.standalone: At what time should a new Northwind Payments employee arrive on their first day?
expected_texts: Day 1: arrive at reception at 09:30.

turns.user: Which accounts will be set up for me then?
turns.standalone: Which accounts does IT create for a new Northwind Payments employee on their first day?
expected_texts: On day 1 IT creates your email, Slack, PeopleHub and Vaultkeep accounts.

turns.user: I heard I get a buddy. How long does that last?
turns.standalone: How long does the buddy programme for new Northwind Payments employees last?
expected_texts: The buddy programme lasts for your first 90 days.

turns.user: How often do we meet?
turns.standalone: How often does a new Northwind Payments employee meet with their onboarding buddy?
expected_texts: You and your buddy meet for 30 minutes every week.

turns.user: And probation, how long is it? I'm joining in Stockholm.
turns.standalone: How long is the probation period for a new Northwind Payments employee in the Stockholm office?
expected_texts: The probation period is 6 months for employees in Barcelona and Stockholm.

turns.user: OK. Now about working from home: how many days a week is that allowed?
turns.standalone: How many days per week may Northwind Payments employees work from home?
expected_texts: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.

turns.user: So which days do I have to come in?
turns.standalone: On which days of the week are Northwind Payments employees expected to be in the office?
expected_texts: Tuesday and Thursday are anchor days, when everyone is expected in the office.

turns.user: Do I get any money to set it up?
turns.standalone: Does Northwind Payments give employees money to set up a home office, and how much?
expected_texts: New joiners receive a one-off home office allowance of 500 EUR.

turns.user: When is it paid?
turns.standalone: When is the Northwind Payments home office allowance paid to a new employee?
expected_texts: The allowance is paid with the first payroll after your first 30 days at the company.

turns.user: Will they also cover my electricity bill for those days?
turns.standalone: Does Northwind Payments pay the home electricity bill of employees for the days they work from home?

turns.user: Fine. Switching to expenses: what's the limit for a taxi?
turns.standalone: What is the maximum amount Northwind Payments reimburses for a taxi ride?
expected_texts: Taxis and ride-hailing: up to 45 EUR per ride.

turns.user: Do I need a receipt for that?
turns.standalone: Is a receipt required to claim a taxi ride as an expense at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: A receipt is required for every expense above 15 EUR.

turns.user: What if I lose it?
turns.standalone: What should a Northwind Payments employee do if they lose the receipt for an expense?
expected_texts: If a receipt is lost, fill in form FIN-09 (Missing Receipt Declaration).

turns.user: How many times can I do that?
turns.standalone: How many times can a Northwind Payments employee use the missing receipt declaration?
expected_texts: Each employee may use the missing receipt declaration at most 2 times per quarter.

turns.user: A colleague's claim came back with EXP-415. What does that one mean?
turns.standalone: What does the expense rejection code EXP-415 mean at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: EXP-415: the claim was submitted after the deadline.

turns.user: One last area, security. How long does my password need to be?
turns.standalone: What is the minimum password length required by Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.

turns.user: Do I have to change it every few months?
turns.standalone: Do Northwind Payments employees have to change their password on a regular schedule?
expected_texts: You do not need to change a password on a schedule; change it only when a compromise is suspected.

turns.user: Can I get the second factor by text message?
turns.standalone: Can SMS text messages be used as the second factor for multi-factor authentication at Northwind Payments?
expected_texts: One-time codes sent by SMS are not accepted as a second factor.

turns.user: Who leads that team, by the way?
turns.standalone: What is the name of the person who leads the Security team at Northwind Payments?

turns.user: And if I get a dodgy email, what should I do with it?
turns.standalone: What should a Northwind Payments employee do with a suspicious email that may be phishing?
expected_texts: button in the mail client instead of forwarding it
